papers.one_line_mechanism: Crystal structure of SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b bound to human TOM70 shows Orf9b occupies the TOM70 cytosolic C-terminal HSP70/HSP90-binding pocket, suggesting displacement of chaperone-mediated preprotein import.
papers.title: Crystal structure of SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b in complex with human TOM70 suggests unusual virus-host interactions.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Biophysical characterization confirms SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b binds the mitochondrial translocase receptor TOM70, occupying its chaperone-docking groove.
papers.title: Binding of SARS-CoV-2 protein ORF9b to mitochondrial translocase TOM70 prevents its interaction with chaperone HSP90.

papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b suppresses type I interferon responses by targeting TOM70, blocking the TOM70–MAVS mitochondrial antiviral signaling axis.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b suppresses type I interferon responses by targeting TOM70.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Phosphorylation of SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b regulates its targeting to two binding sites in TOM70 and its recruitment of Hsp90, tuning the Orf9b–TOM70 chaperone interface.
papers.title: Phosphorylation of SARS-CoV-2 Orf9b Regulates Its Targeting to Two Binding Sites in TOM70 and Recruitment of Hsp90.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Orf9b binding to TOM70 modulates mitochondrial protein biogenesis, dampening import of TOM70-dependent substrates during infection.
papers.title: The Orf9b protein of SARS-CoV-2 modulates mitochondrial protein biogenesis.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: Molecular chaperones Hsp90 and Hsp70 dock onto the TPR domain of the outer-membrane receptor Tom70 via their C-terminal EEVD motifs to deliver preproteins to the mitochondrial import machinery.
neighbor_papers.title: Molecular chaperones Hsp90 and Hsp70 deliver preproteins to the mitochondrial import receptor Tom70.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: Hsp90 ATPase activity functions in targeting and outer-membrane translocation of preproteins through the Tom70 receptor, coupling chaperone cycling to mitochondrial import.
neighbor_papers.title: Hsp90 functions in the targeting and outer membrane translocation steps of Tom70-mediated mitochondrial import.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: A network of cytosolic (co)chaperones acting through Tom70 promotes the biogenesis of mitochondrial signal-anchored outer-membrane proteins by delivering substrates to the import receptor.
neighbor_papers.title: A network of cytosolic (co)chaperones promotes the biogenesis of mitochondrial signal-anchored outer membrane proteins.
